Hey [Friend's Name]! 🌟

I wanted to catch up and tell you about a new hobby I've been really into lately – it's calligraphy! 🖋️ I've been practicing different styles and techniques, and I've found it to be super relaxing and creative. It's like coloring, but with ink and paper!

What I love most about it is how it's helped me reduce stress. You know how busy life can get, right? It's nice to have something that just helps clear my mind and give me a break.
